description: Live web search: ranked results plus Google's answer box, knowledge graph, people-also-ask and related searches when the Google-backed provider answers. This is a PAID x402 call: $0.01 USDC on Base at GET /api/search. This tool returns the payment resource to call; it does not run the search. Params: query (string, required); count (integer 1-20, default 10); country/language/page/device (optional).

device.description: Forwarded to the upstream provider if set; not confirmed to change results on every provider. Optional.

name: search_web
